implementation: Field, Radio Group/Radio Card, Group, Textarea, Input, Select/Option, Alert and Button composition
Canonical immutable FeedbackValue and topic snapshots
Application-owned submission, pending and failure; no network/endpoint/metadata collection
Native validation, whole-form edit events, optional email/topic, reset to first-render supplied value
Separate Toggle Tip/Dialog compositions retain draft and own overlay behavior
engineering: Accepted submission blocks duplicates until the app resolves status, supplies an error, replaces/edits value or resets. Canceled requests retain an available form.
requestSubmit waits for current shared controls before native validation; same-turn value changes cannot submit stale rendered values.
Empty optional selections pass undefined to the canonical selection controls.
Tall Toggle Tip content uses Floating UI size after flip and a scrollable inner region, keeping the close control visible.
Pointer-driven WebKit blur to document body inside Toggle Tip no longer counts as an outside focus move; actual outside focus and keyboard departure remain independently verified.
Ratings preserve the four existing text meanings and use descriptive string values.

reference.review: Complete size middleware docs: nonnegative available height, border-box overflow and bestFit flip before size.
